question: For the port with ID `25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034`, group the results by the port’s security group ID and whether the port is administratively up (`Admin Up` vs `Admin Down`). For each group, show the security group ID, the admin-up label, the number of allowed address pairs, the number of distinct allowed address pair IP addresses, and the total port-security-enabled count across bindings. Include subtotals per security group and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    sgb.security_group_id,
    CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 THEN 'Admin Up' ELSE 'Admin Down' END AS admin_label,
    aap.ip_address,
    psb.port_security_enabled
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN allowedaddresspairs aap ON aap.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.id = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034'
)
SELECT
  security_group_id,
  admin_label,
  COUNT(ip_address) AS allowed_address_pairs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS distinct_ip_addresses,
  SUM(port_security_enabled) AS port_security_enabled_count
FROM base
GROUP BY security_group_id, admin_label
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY security_group_id, admin_label
